confirmed_alignments: Normal and synthetic process configs differ only by frontend path/identity and normal config is not executed.
Copied Faux relative import/import.meta path design is coherent with copied controller-main verification.
Bridge/gate bootstraps are fixed module entries with empty external argv and config hashes.
Native session end equality is deliberately strict; post-gate append must fail rather than use an implicit prefix.
Faux has two IDs, one public-read tool call, no fallback/third response, and native session usage remains authority.
Acceptance is pure and does not manufacture gate or hidden-score evidence.

findings.correction: Freeze a separate synthetic-only materializer/allowlist and SourceTree output for exact reviewed combination members. Keep production RUNTIME_NAMES unchanged.
findings.evidence: Combination contracts require combination_driver.py, combination_fixture.py, combination_acceptance.py and test_bridge.py in the synthetic namespace. deployment_assets.RUNTIME_NAMES/MEMBER_PATHS omit them and materialize_namespace rejects unlisted members.
findings.impact: There is no reviewed way to create the SourceTree that CombinationCaseConfig requires; broadening the production allowlist would mix test-only code into production materialization.
findings.title: Frozen namespace materializer cannot build the contracted synthetic namespace

findings.correction: Freeze a root-only one-shot pre-import entry/caller that opens a bounded config, verifies synthetic namespace and installed Prime using already sealed code, then execs a fixed module with no user argv. No sys.path mutation/dynamic import workaround.
findings.evidence: run_case is callable only after static importing combination_driver and its fixture/acceptance dependencies. Internal verification is therefore too late. write_module_bootstrap allows only bridge and phase_gate, and the driver has no CLI or frozen external caller.
findings.impact: The stated verify-before-import invariant cannot be implemented from the current contracts.
findings.title: Required pre-import namespace seal has no executable entry contract

findings.correction: Freeze close()->FixtureCloseResult or exact bool semantics, first/repeated call behavior, bounded shutdown deadline and unknown/exception mapping. Bind it in the final receipt.
findings.evidence: Case output requires cleanup_confirmed and CLEANUP_UNCONFIRMED, but CombinationFixture.close() has no frozen return/result fields or confirmed-shutdown semantics.
findings.impact: The driver would have to invent cleanup truth or treat absence of exception as confirmation.
findings.title: Fixture cleanup confirmation has no typed producer interface

findings.correction: Freeze strict parsed PublicResult -> exact {ok:true,result:parsed} reconstruction with phase_gate canonical encoder, plus exact tool name/call ID/error checks. Any native shape drift is TOOL_TRANSCRIPT_INVALID.
findings.evidence: controller-extension formatResult emits PublicResult JSON alone. phase_gate hashes the full {ok:true,result:PublicResult} Bridge envelope. The I/O addendum says canonical envelope but does not specify the exact reconstruction.
findings.impact: Direct hashes cannot match; implementations may drift or accept incompatible native wrappers.
findings.title: Native public tool-result and gate public-view hash use different shapes

findings.correction: Freeze exact per-file/aggregate/count/mode limits and descriptor-relative O_EXCL full-write/fsync/reopen semantics. Preserve partial evidence and return existing safe failure without fabricated bindings.
findings.evidence: Metadata, artifact and timing caps exist, but case-admission.json, case-receipt.json, copied process receipt, evidence file count and evidence aggregate bytes have no exact caps.
findings.impact: The root driver cannot implement a single auditably bounded output writer from the contract.
findings.title: Case evidence publication limits are not frozen
